title: Verbos de conjetura, sospecha y distanciamiento epistémico
goal: Employ journalistic distancing verbs (alegar, conjeturar, insinuar) to report claims without committing to their truth value.
grammar: verbos de distanciamiento epistémico, cautela informativa y conjetura en la prensa

items: Deploy 'alegar que' to report unverified legal claims neutrally.
Indicate subtle oblique hints using 'insinuar que'.
Frame analytical hypotheses and speculative scenarios using 'conjeturar' and 'especular'.
